title: Undo that merges drags
description:
Record edits as commands, and merge many small slider moves into one undo step.

```
drag speed 2.5 -> 2.6 -> 2.8 -> 3.0 (one drag)
undo -> 2.5 (the whole drag at once)
set name "Orc", undo -> "Goblin", redo -> "Orc"
```
hints: `ImGui::IsItemActivated()` and `ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()` tell you when a drag starts and ends (lesson 5.04).
In `record`, if dragging and the last command has the same field, set its `after` and return.
requirements: A `Command` holds the field, the old value and the new value (as text is fine).
While a drag is active (between "begin" and "end"), new edits of the same field update the last command's new value instead of adding one.
Undo and redo stacks; a new command clears redo.
stretch: Group several field changes made by one button (like "Reset") into one undo step.
